driverFormulas.rev: Revenue = Gross Revenue − Rebates & Credit Notes
driverFormulas.cogs: Direct Transport Costs = Subcontracted Transport + Direct Labour + Fuel, Fleet & Hubs
driverFormulas.gp: Agency Contribution Margin = Revenue − Direct Transport Costs
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Agency Contribution Margin % = Contribution Margin / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Overheads = Sales & Customer Service + IT, Data & TMS + Agency Overheads & HQ
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Fleet + Hubs & Warehouses + IT & Software
driverFormulas.nonop: Financial Result & Other = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Financial Result
driverFormulas.ni: Net Income = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Net Income / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Unbilled & Stocks + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Unbilled Shipments & Stocks = Unbilled Shipments + Customs Duties Advanced + Fuel & Parts
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Carrier Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Income
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Net Income + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
driverFormulas.cf-ni: Eliminates duplicate planning of Net Income and ensures the cash flow statement automatically reconciles with the P&L. This is standard accounting practice — the starting point of the indirect cash flow method should always be the bottom line from the income statement.
driverFormulas.cogs-pct: This KPI provides immediate visibility into the cost structure of Heppner's transport operations, enabling management to track operational efficiency and benchmark against industry standards. It complements the existing Agency Contribution Margin % (gp-pct) by isolating the largest cost component.
